style: Editorial lifestyle photograph for Maison Maho, a travel-wear and lifestyle brand. High summer, bright clear morning sunlight, crisp shadows, fresh airy palette of white, ivory, sand, sea blue, terracotta and olive. Shot on 35mm film, shallow depth of field, natural skin, candid and unposed. Mediterranean coastal setting. No text, no lettering, no logos, no watermark, no borders.
